text:
Maya: Impromptu midday duel: 20-min boulder sesh at the wall vs 4x400m repeats on the track. Which one wins? :rock_climbing: :running_shirt_with_sash: 
Diego: I'll take the wall if there's an overhang. Otherwise repeats for my ego. :sweat_smile: 
Sophie: I vote track. I can pace and yell encouraging things. Loud encouragement included. :megaphone: 
Luca: Track sounds faster to return to my desk. But bouldering for the novelty. Can we do both and call it a triathlon? :thinking_face: 
Maya: Love the chaos. Rule: you pick one activity and stick to it. Whoever convinces someone from another group to switch gets a consolation gel. :gel: 
fit-bot: Event created: "Midday Duel: Boulder vs Repeats" — 12:20 tomorrow. Optional. Safety: warm up recommended.
Diego: RSVP: boulder. I'll bring chalk and a rope to tape the holds.
Sophie: RSVP: track. I'll bring a stopwatch and a backing playlist. 
Luca: RSVP: undecided wobble. Propose winner picks Saturday snack run.
Maya: Deal. Also tiny prize: winner chooses playlist for the team call. Loser buys bagels. Stakes set. :bagel: 
Sophie: Also PSA: track lanes 1 and 2 reserved at 12:15 for yoga class. We'll use 3 and 4.
Diego: Cool. See you all — may the best mid-lunch athlete win. :muscle:
